desc:
Play as your favorite Unstable Universe characters in this Unstable SMP simulator. Fight just like in Java 1.21.11.

🛡️ SIMULATOR
Fight the armies of the Unstable SMP, from NULL and The Law to Cindercrest and the Kingdom of Unstable. Play alone or in a group of up to 10. Face up to 100 soldiers who fight back and heal.

👤 PLAY AS
Pick from 28 characters, like Wemmbu, ParrotX2, SpokeIsHere, FlameFrags and ManePear. Unlock The Wraith to turn invisible.

⚔️ FREE FOR ALL
Start with your character’s own gear and armor trims. Lunge with a spear or smash foes with a mace. Fly with an elytra and rockets. Use wind charges, pearls, tridents and TNT carts to fight other players. Try a duel or test your moves on the Practice Dummy.

🗺️ THREE ARENAS
Fight at Northern Council, MinuteTech's End Base and FlameFrags & Wemmbu's 2v1000. The arena changes every 15 minutes.

🎮 Play on PC, on your phone or with a controller. You can change what each button does.
